_comment_timing: The 3000ms gap is the window the test must land an abort inside. It is deliberately far wider than the abort needs: on a loaded CI runner a `dispatch` subprocess plus a control-socket round trip took over 150ms, the previous gap, and the natural agent_end settled the epoch `success` before the abort was even requested — which measures runner load, not epoch attribution. Widening costs the suite three seconds and removes the race entirely.
_comment: SRD 7.5: abort issued, but the turn completes naturally before the abort lands. The abort step emits nothing and cancels nothing; a straggler duplicate terminal event follows later. The second prompt (T-005) emits nothing at all - it must never be reported complete off the back of epoch N's events.
